notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}
When The Great Henge enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Great Henge, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
